title: Previous-snapshot source translation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $N,T,t$ be natural numbers. Let $\ell$ be a list of bit sources of length $N$, and assign a natural number to each of the eleven registers, with register $LB$ equal to $t$ times the configuration stride for $M$, input length $N$, and time bound $T$. Translating the snapshot source list of width equal to the number of possible snapshots of $M$, using the flag that is true exactly when $t=0$, yields the list of sources for the preceding snapshot at time $t$.
